newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield falls to 0.58 pct on Bulgaria 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield falls to 0.58 pct on Bulgaria 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Yield fell further on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry four-week discount T-bills at the daily auction on Friday as the issue was oversubscribed, central bank figures showed.

The average yield to maturity on the issue was 0.58 percent, down from 0.62 percent on Thursday, 0.69 on Wednesday and 0.72 on Tuesday. Yields stood at 0.78 percent and 0.90 percent on Monday and Friday, respectively, figures showed.
The issue was offered with a par value of 15 billion levs and no minimum acceptable price set in advance.
